submittedParameters.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Produce one native 1254 x 1254 opaque square game-map patch for a seamless Chinese Taoist chibi hand-painted daytime city. Image 1 is the exact coordinate/layout guide for this patch r07_c07/s02_03_native01; image 2 is a wider layout-only orientation reference, not an image to reproduce at full extent. Fill precisely image 1's field of view at exactly 1254 x 1254. World box [26509, 25485, 27763, 26739], center core crop [115,115,1139,1139]. Sharp existing native CORE anchor bands at image-1 pixel boxes [[115, 0, 1139, 115], [1139, 0, 1254, 115], [1139, 115, 1254, 1139]] are authoritative neighboring artwork; preserve their line positions, color, stone/wood scale and continuation. The blurry remainder supplies geometry only: render fresh crisp native details throughout that area. Continue all crossing edges smoothly with unchanged scale and camera, without rectangular borders or shifted intersections. Continue the pale cream-gray stone platform directly beneath the red-and-gold pillar. The gold footing is almost entirely above this patch; preserve only its cropped edge at top. Main field is the pale top of a projecting square stone pedestal, with a rounded red-painted architectural plinth/trim at upper left as shown in the layout. Its thick gray vertical stone face enters across the lower quarter, following the original ledge shape. At far right, continue the cropped gray stone lion shoulder from the actual right strip with the identical silhouette and light/shadow. Keep every top paving joint continuous and do not add a horizontal border at y=115. No new free-standing objects or decorations. Warm hand-painted natural pale gray/blue-gray ground, jade/teal architectural accents where shown, restrained warm gold, subtle soft natural daytime shading matching anchors. Preserve the approved layout and existing objects only. No added people, writing, UI, new decorative items, trees, lamps or buildings. No lettering, crop marks, watermarks, fake detail from enlargement, blur, haze or dense noise. Output only the finished full square patch, no collage or comparison.
